mapper.select: SELECT a.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id, a.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm, a.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no, a.sys06_seq AS seq, a.sys06_parent_id AS parent_id, a.sys06_class_nm AS class_nm, NULL AS parent_menu_nm, NULL AS parent_seq FROM sys06_menu a INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON a.sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id WHERE sys03_use_yn = 'true' AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys06_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sys06_seq, sys06_menu_nm

SELECT a.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id, a.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm, a.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no, a.sys06_seq AS seq, a.sys06_parent_id AS parent_id, a.sys06_class_nm AS class_nm, NULL AS parent_menu_nm, NULL AS parent_seq FROM ( SELECT a.sys06_menu_id, a.sys06_menu_nm, a.sys06_menu_no, a.sys06_seq, a.sys06_parent_id, a.sys06_class_nm FROM sys06_menu a INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON a.sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id INNER JOIN sys07_role_menu ON a.sys06_menu_id = sys07_menu_id AND sys07_use_yn = 'true' , sys05_user_role WHERE sys07_role_id = sys05_role_id AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys06_parent_id = #{parentId} AND sys05_user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT a.sys06_menu_id, a.sys06_menu_nm, a.sys06_menu_no, a.sys06_seq, a.sys06_parent_id, a.sys06_class_nm FROM sys06_menu a INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON a.sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id INNER JOIN sys07_role_menu ON a.sys06_menu_id = sys07_menu_id AND sys07_use_yn = 'true' , sys04_role WHERE sys04_role_id = sys07_role_id AND sys04_company_id = sys03_company_id AND sys04_default_role = 'true' AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys06_parent_id = #{parentId} ) a ORDER BY a.sys06_seq, a.sys06_menu_nm

SELECT sys.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id, sys.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm, sys.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no, sys.sys06_seq AS seq, sys.sys06_parent_id AS parent_id, sys.sys06_class_nm AS class_nm, (SELECT sys06_menu_nm FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_menu_id = sys.sys06_parent_id) AS parent_menu_nm, (SELECT sys06_seq FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_menu_id = sys.sys06_parent_id) AS parent_seq FROM sys06_menu sys INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON sys.sys06_menu_id = sys03_menu_id WHERE sys03_use_yn = 'true' AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys06_parent_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE sys06_menu_down (sys06_menu_id, sys06_parent_id, depth, path) AS ( SELECT a.sys06_menu_id, a.sys06_parent_id, 0, ARRAY[a.sys06_parent_id::text] FROM sys06_menu a WHERE sys06_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION ALL SELECT a.sys06_menu_id, a.sys06_parent_id, b.depth + 1, ARRAY_APPEND(b.path, a.sys06_parent_id::text) FROM sys06_menu a, sys06_menu_down b WHERE a.sys06_parent_id = b.sys06_menu_id ) SELECT a.sys06_menu_id FROM sys06_menu_down a ) ORDER BY sys06_seq, sys06_menu_nm

WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT m.sys06_menu_id, m.sys06_parent_id, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[m.sys06_parent_id::text] AS path FROM sys06_menu m WHERE m.sys06_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION ALL SELECT m.sys06_menu_id, m.sys06_parent_id, s.depth + 1, array_append(s.path, m.sys06_parent_id::text) FROM sys06_menu m INNER JOIN subtree s ON m.sys06_parent_id = s.sys06_menu_id ) SELECT DISTINCT m06.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id, m06.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm, m06.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no, m06.sys06_seq AS seq, m06.sys06_parent_id AS parent_id, m06.sys06_class_nm AS class_nm, (SELECT sys06_menu_nm FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_menu_id = m06.sys06_parent_id) AS parent_menu_nm, (SELECT sys06_seq FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_menu_id = m06.sys06_parent_id) AS parent_seq FROM sys06_menu m06 INNER JOIN sys07_role_menu rm ON m06.sys06_menu_id = rm.sys07_menu_id AND rm.sys07_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu cm ON m06.sys06_menu_id = cm.sys03_menu_id AND cm.sys03_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys05_user_role ur ON rm.sys07_role_id = ur.sys05_role_id WHERE cm.sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND ur.sys05_user_id = #{userId} AND m06.sys06_menu_id IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM subtree WHERE depth = 1) UNION SELECT DISTINCT m06.sys06_menu_id, m06.sys06_menu_nm, m06.sys06_menu_no, m06.sys06_seq, m06.sys06_parent_id, m06.sys06_class_nm, (SELECT sys06_menu_nm FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_menu_id = m06.sys06_parent_id), (SELECT sys06_seq FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_menu_id = m06.sys06_parent_id) FROM sys06_menu m06 INNER JOIN sys07_role_menu rm ON m06.sys06_menu_id = rm.sys07_menu_id AND rm.sys07_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu cm ON m06.sys06_menu_id = cm.sys03_menu_id AND cm.sys03_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys04_role r ON r.sys04_role_id = rm.sys07_role_id AND r.sys04_company_id = cm.sys03_company_id AND r.sys04_default_role = 'true' WHERE cm.sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND m06.sys06_menu_id IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM subtree WHERE depth = 1) ORDER BY seq, menu_nm
